extracted.intended_audience: NIH peer reviewers, review chairs, and scientific review officers evaluating Research Project Grant (RPG) applications
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for reviewers on evaluating and scoring NIH Research Project Grant (RPG) applications under the Simplified Review Framework, which retains the five regulatory criteria but reorganizes them into three factors and changes how some items are scored or assessed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significance
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the five regulatory criteria retained under the simplified review framework: 'Significance'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The criterion is retained but reorganized into the simplified framework's three Factors. Reviewers should evaluate Significance as described in the linked Reviewer Guide and Scoring Guidance; its assessment will be included in one of the three Factors that inform the Overall Impact score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigators
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the five regulatory criteria retained under the simplified review framework: 'Investigators'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The criterion is retained but reorganized into the simplified framework's three Factors. Reviewers should assess the qualifications, expertise, and suitability of the investigators per the Reviewer Guide; the resulting assessment will feed into the applicable Factor score or sufficiency determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the five regulatory criteria retained under the simplified review framework: 'Innovation'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The criterion is retained but reorganized into the simplified framework's three Factors. Reviewers should judge the novelty and innovativeness of the proposed work following guidance in the Reviewer Guide and Scoring Guidance; this assessment contributes to the Factor-based evaluation and the Overall Impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approach
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the five regulatory criteria retained under the simplified review framework: 'Approach'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The criterion is retained but reorganized into the simplified framework's three Factors. Reviewers should evaluate rigor, feasibility, and methodology as outlined in the Reviewer Guide; Approach assessments are captured in the Factor scores and influence the Overall Impact score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the five regulatory criteria retained under the simplified review framework: 'Environment'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The criterion is retained but reorganized into the simplified framework's three Factors. Reviewers should assess institutional and resource support per guidance; Environment evaluation will be folded into the appropriate Factor and considered when assigning the Overall Impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Three-factor organization and scoring
rubrics_metrics.description: The simplified review framework reorganizes the five regulatory criteria into three Factors. 'Factors 1 and 2 will receive numerical criterion scores and Factor 3 will be evaluated for sufficiency.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All three Factors are considered in arriving at the Overall Impact score, along with the Additional Review Criteria. Reviewers must apply numeric scoring to Factors 1 and 2 per the Scoring Guidance documents and evaluate Factor 3 for sufficiency (pass/fail or adequate/inadequate) as instructed in reviewer materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall Impact score
rubrics_metrics.description: An Overall Impact score is assigned to applications and is informed by the three Factors and the Additional Review Criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers use the Factor scores (Factors 1 & 2 numeric; Factor 3 sufficiency) plus consideration of Additional Review Criteria to arrive at the Overall Impact score. Detailed procedures and examples for how factors should inform the Overall Impact are provided in the linked Scoring Guidance and Reviewer Guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Review Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional Review Criteria (beyond the five regulatory criteria/factors) remain part of the assessment and are considered alongside the Factors when determining Overall Impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These Additional Review Criteria are considered in conjunction with the three Factors during the Overall Impact determination. Specific treatment and examples are available in the Reviewer Guide and Scoring Guidance linked on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Review Considerations moved to NIH staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Some Additional Review Considerations — specifically 'Applications from Foreign Organizations, Select Agents, and Resource Sharing Plans' — will be shifted from reviewers to NIH staff for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers will not be responsible for assessing these specific considerations; NIH staff will handle them. Reviewers should be aware these items remain part of the overall administrative/ compliance picture but are not part of the reviewer scoring task under the simplified framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use reviewer resources and training materials
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH provides multiple resources to help reviewers apply the simplified review framework (e.g., videos, Reviewer Guide to Evaluating Applications, Scoring Guidance, Reviewer Training Slides, Discussion and Chair Cheat Sheets).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers should consult these materials for detailed instructions, examples, scoring approaches, and meeting discussion guidance. The page lists and links: Video Introduction to the Simplified Review Framework; Reviewer Guide to Evaluating Applications; Scoring Guidance; Reviewer Training Slides; Chair Orientation materials; Reviewer and Chair Discussion Cheat Sheets; and related recordings and slide decks.
